description: Told David he had '90 minutes' before the McMichael call. Did not check actual current time via osascript before making time-sensitive statements. Current time was 10:47 AM CT — 13 minutes before the call, not 90. This directly misled David about available prep time.
correction: Current time is 10:47 AM CT. McMichael call is at 11:00 AM CT — 13 minutes away.
proposed_fix: Always pull current time via osascript before making any time-gap calculation in a briefing. Never compute 'time until' from calendar data alone without anchoring to actual current time.
